# vibey

> vibey is a free, open-source orchestrator for AI coding agents: it interviews you until the spec is sharp, builds unattended on local or paid agents, stops only for the decisions that are yours, and records every step in an append-only PostgreSQL ledger, so a crashed or out-of-credit agent's work is picked up again rather than lost.

This index is generated from the documentation's navigation by `scripts/llms_txt.py`; every link is the production copy of a page. The source is https://github.com/the-vibey-project/vibey, and the pages there are the same Markdown.

## Start here

- [Home](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/): The documentation home — what vibey is, who it is for, what makes it different, how to try it, and how to contribute in your first hour.
- [Current estimate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/estimate/): This page is a generated, append-only-ledger-backed forecast.
- [Research paper](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/paper/): A single autonomous coding session is not autonomous software delivery: sessions lose context across crashes, exhaust one vendor's capacity mid-task, and carry no structure for the human decisions delivery legally and…

## Guides

- [VS Code extension](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/vscode-extension/): The extension is called krypton, the name every app carries (sub-doctrine 9.e); its commands and settings keep their vibey.* names.
- [Kubernetes](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/kubernetes/): This guide takes vibey from a laptop process to a long-lived deployment: a containerized worker, a Helm chart, an in-cluster PostgreSQL, and queue-depth autoscaling via KEDA.
- [Greeter live demo](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/greeter-live-demo/): This runbook drives one small project ("a CLI greeter") end to end on real *loop binaries: DESIGN through the interactive interview, BUILD on engine-selected sessions, REVIEW with real automated gates, and DONE(local).
- [Local models on Ollama](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/local-models-ollama/): Sub-doctrine 8.a makes the sovereign path the preferred way to run vibey, not the fallback.
- [Convergence-Driven Development](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/convergence-driven-development/): Convergence-Driven Development (CDD) is the delivery loop above Specification-Driven Development (SDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
- [What gets published](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/ledger-publication/): vibey ledger export never publishes your ledger.
- [Continuous delivery estimate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/delivery-estimate/): vibey-gh forecast maintains the current delivery estimate from real repository history.
- [Self-hosted sovereign surfaces](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/self-hosted-surfaces/): vibey orchestrates software delivery end-to-end on sovereign defaults: every operational dependency — issue tracking, documentation, secrets, files, email, SMS, messaging, configuration store, caching, message bus…
- [The Sabbath](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/sabbath/): From sundown on Friday to sundown on Saturday, vibey rests.
- [Sovereign review runner](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/runbooks/sovereign-review-runner/): How to stand up, verify and remove the self-hosted runner that runs pr-review.yml's review-sovereign job on [self-hosted, vibey-local-vibey] (sub-doctrine 8.a).

## What do you want to do?

- [Overview](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/): Six short guides, each answering one question people bring to AI coding agents, with the commands, the evidence behind every claim, and the limits.
- [Run agents on your own hardware](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/run-agents-on-your-own-hardware/): Run vibey on its default engine, GPT-OSS 20B on Ollama, and allow only that engine; the queue, the ledger and the model then stay on one machine, and the measured sovereign path needs no internet at runtime.
- [Cap and trace agent spending](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/cap-agent-spending/): Set a per-cycle dollar or turn cap with vibey budget set; the brake reads it before every BUILD session and parks a gate when it trips, and vibey cost shows each engine's spend from the ledger.
- [Keep a tamper-evident record](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/keep-a-tamper-evident-record/): vibey appends every decision, question, answer, handoff and cost to a PostgreSQL ledger that its application role cannot rewrite, and each export walks a SHA-256 chain over every event to show an edit.
- [Review AI changes before merge](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/review-ai-changes-before-merge/): vibey stops at a REVIEW gate that waits for your verdict, and vibey-gh binds every check and review on a GitHub pull request to its exact head commit, so the merge train merges only what passed on that commit.
- [Deploy without holding cloud secrets](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/deploy-without-storing-secrets/): Partly, and not yet for production; vibey's opt-in Azure stages keep no cloud credential, act as the az CLI identity you signed in with, and change nothing until you consent, but no real-Azure run is proven yet.
- [Use vibey in a regulated environment](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/guides/outcomes/take-vibey-into-a-regulated-environment/): vibey holds no certification, but it gives an assessor concrete mechanisms to examine, each linked to its evidence, and it says plainly which controls stay with you.

## Case studies

- [How vibey survives a crashed agent](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/case-studies/how-vibey-survives-a-crashed-agent/): When an AI coding agent crashes mid-task, vibey loses no job and commits no job twice — leases, an append-only ledger and parked human gates, with the chaos test that proves it and the costs it pays.

## Reference

- [CLI](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/cli/): Every vibey command and subcommand, written by hand against src/vibey/cli/main.py and checked against it as of 2026-09-29.
- [Configuration](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/configuration/): The schema below is fully implemented and unit-tested in src/vibey/domain/config.py (VibeyConfig, parse_config, parse_toml_string) and src/vibey/infrastructure/config_loader.py (load_config_from_path). vibey new reads…
- [Hub API](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/hub-api/): The hub is vibey serve (ADR-0068): one HTTP API that every Krypton client -- desktop, mobile, web, the VS Code extension -- reaches.
- [System requirements](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/reference/system-requirements/): What a machine needs to run vibey and its Krypton clients, and how each figure is known.
- [Context microslices](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/context-microslices/): This is the implementation contract for proposed doctrine 10.k and ADR-0075.

## Design

- [The design system](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/design/): Every colour, face, size, space, radius, shadow, curve and sound cue that a vibey surface uses comes from one place: design/tokens/.
- [Motion](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/design/motion/): Motion in vibey and krypton explains.
- [The Beauty Bar](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/design/beauty-bar/): The checkable bar that sub-doctrine 12.k (beauty is the first measure) cites.

## Architecture — Decision records

- [0001 — Orchestrate the *loop runners; do not reimplement them](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0001-orchestrate-do-not-reimplement/)
- [0002 — PostgreSQL, not SQLite, for the queue and ledger](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0002-postgres-not-sqlite/)
- [0003 — An event-sourced ledger is the conversation's source of truth](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0003-event-sourced-ledger/)
- [0004 — Handoffs are gated by a deterministic no-loss predicate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0004-no-loss-gate-on-handoff/)
- [0005 — Smooth weighted round robin, not modulo rotation](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0005-smooth-weighted-round-robin/)
- [0006 — A normalized effort ladder with saturating per-engine projection](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0006-normalized-effort-ladder/)
- [0007 — Rotate at boundaries, never mid-turn](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0007-rotate-at-boundaries/)
- [0008 — Git worktree per work item; containers for real isolation](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0008-worktree-isolation/)
- [0009 — Human gates park jobs; they never block workers](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0009-human-gates-are-parked-jobs/)
- [0010 — Review loops back to design by default, to build on the fast path](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0010-review-loopback-routing/)
- [0011 — One source of truth, materialized into every engine's guidance files](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0011-agent-surface-provisioning/)
- [0012 — Deployment is a separate CLI built on azure-bootstrap](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0012-deploy-is-a-separate-cli/)
- [0013 — Deployment is a three-phase stage set in the core lifecycle](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0013-deployment-is-a-three-phase-stage-set/)
- [0014 — Optional visual design and deployment opt-in gates](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0014-optional-visual-design-and-deployment-opt-in/)
- [0015 — qwenloop is an opt-in local engine — a standby tier for BUILD, the sovereign provider for DESIGN](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0015-qwenloop-standby/)
- [0016 — Code lives in classes, and every class has an interface beside it](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0016-classes-behind-interfaces/)
- [0017 — If the family already does it, the family does it here](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0017-dogfood-the-family-first/)
- [0018 — If it can be declared in the repository, it is declared in the repository](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0018-everything-as-code/)
- [0019 — Vibey is installable wherever its users already are](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0019-installable-wherever-its-users-are/)
- [0020 — A governing rule belongs in the canon, ratified, or it is not a rule](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0020-governing-rules-are-ratified-subdoctrines/)
- [0021 — One tree, history preserved — the family is absorbed as subtrees in a uv workspace](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0021-one-tree-history-preserved/)
- [0022 — An absorbed package keeps every gate it was already held to](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0022-absorbed-packages-keep-their-own-gates/)
- [0023 — Four layers, four floors — 100% branch coverage per layer, each its own gate](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0023-four-layers-four-floors/)
- [0024 — Every bounded ladder ends in a park that can grant more](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0024-every-bounded-ladder-parks-with-a-grant/)
- [0025 — Kubernetes — a chart, KEDA on claimable work, and an operator that never grows its own logic](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0025-kubernetes-operator-crd-keda/)
- [0026 — tini is PID 1, and the SIGTERM latch is armed before the first import](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0026-tini-pid1-and-the-sigterm-latch/)
- [0027 — A sovereign DESIGN provider — phase one runs without paid credit](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0027-sovereign-design-provider/)

- [0029 — Integrates are serialized by a Postgres advisory lock, and contention is a Defer](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0029-integrate-serialized-by-advisory-lock/)

- [0037 — One distribution, one version — the whole family ships inside vibey](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0037-one-distribution-one-version/)
- [0038 — Local engines are preferred first (8.a) — claudeloop-local, tiered selection, and sovereign DESIGN/DECOMPOSE by default when enabled](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0038-local-engines-are-preferred-first/)
- [0039 — Convergence-Driven Development (CDD) encloses specification and test-driven development](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0039-convergence-driven-development/)

- [0048 — A job that consumes an accumulating record reads every datum in the gap](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0048-the-unbroken-read/)

- [0051 — Configuration is declared in TOML, never written into a source file](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/architecture/decisions/0051-nothing-is-compiled-in-that-could-be-declared/)

## Governance

- [The Constitution](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/constitution/): The permanent, living governance of this project and its family.
- [The Twelve Doctrines](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/doctrines/): There is no thirteenth and there never will be: anything new files as a sub-doctrine under one of the twelve.
- [The Ten Commandments of Software Engineering](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/commandments/): Binding on every agent that works here — human and machine alike.
- [The Bill of Rights of the Human Software Engineer](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/bill-of-rights/): Nothing is ever added beyond these; from their sealing forward, only refinements of the existing ten are made — refinements that may strengthen a right, never weaken one.
- [Subdoctrine SD-01 — Counterparties, Trust, and Verification](https://the-vibey-project.github.io/vibey/main/governance/sd-01-counterparties-trust-verification/): This page carries a standing rule of this project: how any agent acting for it treats every counterparty — people, companies, executives, states, and other software.
